description: Write one v1 receipt for a read a gate has cleared. Authenticated: Authorization: Bearer <writer token>. Idempotent on (writer, subject, subject_type, market, rule_version, cleared_at, answer_hash). Returns the receipt.

answer_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical answer bytes the agent received

caller.description: who asked, when the gate knows it: x402:<wallet address>; stored only as its sha256

caller_key.description: the customer key the reader presented to the gate (RCO-Key); the door checks it and stores sha256("key:" + key id) as caller

cleared_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC; stored to the second; the door's clock when absent

market.description: ISO country or exchange code of the read

rule_version.description: the rule set and version the gate cleared under

subject.description: what was read: the identifier (an ISIN, LEI, GTIN, ticker, record id …)

subject_type.description: isin | lei | gtin | ticker | cmr | … (open list)

name: write_receipt
